source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check monitor could detect all support resolution and color
MiniDP:
1.Setting all support resolution combine with color quality 16bit or 32bit.
2.Check the full screen display quality

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Make sure the devices can be detected under OS

original_test_intent: Verify the MiniDP monitor is detected by the OS and that every owner-approved supported resolution combined with 16-bit and 32-bit colour produces acceptable full-screen visual quality.
original_method: An engineer enumerates the approved OS/EDID matrix, applies each supported resolution/colour combination through the display UI, confirms OS device detection and visually inspects the full physical screen.
manual_activity: The operator must apply each approved mode/depth and visually judge full-screen signal, colour, scaling and artifacts. OS detection can be queried automatically but cannot satisfy the complete procedure.
required_inputs: OS/GPU/driver and physical MiniDP output mapping
Monitor/cable identities and authoritative EDID/project mode matrix
Definitions of 16-bit/32-bit colour and full-screen quality
Safe mode order, timeouts, maintenance approval and alternate-console rollback
safety_requirements: Do not loop over every enumerated EDID mode without an owner-approved matrix and rollback.
Do not assume OS device detection proves visible output quality.
Keep alternate console and known-good mode before each change.
Stop on no signal, artifacts, wrong colour/scaling, driver error or lost recovery; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate OS device, connector, EDID, supported/active mode and driver state using platform-appropriate read-only methods.
Track matrix coverage and collect per-mode electronic evidence/logs.
Correlate operator visual evidence and flag mismatches without issuing PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the bounded resolution/colour matrix and visual criteria.
Apply each combination and inspect the full physical screen.
Confirm OS detection plus visual quality and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its no-command visual boundary is valid, but POST is not in the source and its summary loses OS detection plus all supported mode/colour combinations.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use OS-native EDID/device/mode inventory only as supporting evidence; retain human full-screen inspection for every approved combination.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All supported resolution/16-bit/32-bit combinations, full-screen quality, OS detection and 5/5-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Generate a reviewable approved matrix from EDID plus project requirements, capture device/mode/depth readback for each entry, show a fixed diagnostic image full-screen, record operator observations, then restore the approved final mode.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record OS build, driver/firmware and EDID revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner display specification and OS/GPU/monitor supported-mode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds bounded matrix tracking and repeatable visual content without replacing human judgment.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No mode/depth combination is silently omitted; POST is not added as substitute coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: EDID enumeration does not guarantee artifact-free rendering or correct colour.

project_override_considerations: A project defines its authoritative supported matrix and may exclude unsupported EDID entries explicitly. Completion is limited to that approved matrix. Missing inputs are readiness gaps, not permanent BLOCKED.
expected_evidence: Per-combination OS detection, mode/depth readback and timestamps
Per-combination full-screen operator photo/observation of signal, colour, scaling and artifacts
Restored final mode, log review and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The broad procedure and narrower OS-detection criterion are cumulative rather than contradictory; both device detection and all-mode visual quality must be retained.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The workflow is clear. The project matrix and visual thresholds are readiness inputs, not a permanent semantic block.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keep the human visual boundary but reject its POST substitution and loss of matrix coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retain its matrix, EDID and rollback analysis while reclassifying to MANUAL ONLY because full-screen visual quality is a core acceptance signal.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Applies semantic retention to both OS-detection and full matrix visual coverage and separates agent evidence from verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a single detected monitor or visible POST image from being overstated as validation of every supported resolution/colour combination.
independent_technical_reasoning: Electronic device and EDID enumeration are automatable, but the source explicitly requires full-screen display-quality judgment across the matrix. That human visual core determines MANUAL ONLY classification.
